description: This Java class 'PersistenceStatusStage' creates an Akka stream graph to retrieve and aggregate persistence health metrics from multiple instances, and outputs either the aggregated status or a credit rejection decision based on the responses received within a timeout.

classes.name: PersistenceStatusStage
classes.description: Final class providing static methods to create an Akka stream graph for retrieving and processing persistence health metrics.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates an Akka stream graph that manages the process of requesting health status reports from multiple instances and outputs either the aggregated status or a credit rejection decision.

methods.name: askAggregator
methods.description: Creates an actor for aggregating responses and sends a request message to it, returning a CompletionStage for the reply.

methods.name: askAggregatorFlow
methods.description: Builds a Flow that asynchronously asks for aggregation results based on expected message counts.

methods.name: checkAggregatorReply
methods.description: Evaluates the aggregated replies to determine if all expected StatusInfo responses were received; returns either a list of StatusInfo or a CreditDecision rejection.

methods.name: safeCastAsStatusInfoList
methods.description: Safely casts an Object to a List of StatusInfo if possible.
